cases.question: If I sell my phone after a repair, does the new owner still have warranty?
cases.answer: Yes, the warranty is tied to the device, not the original customer. The new owner is covered for the remainder of the 90-day warranty period as long as they have the original receipt from the repair [2].

cases.question: What's covered under your repair warranty?
cases.answer: Every repair comes with a 90-day warranty that covers defects in parts and workmanship [2]. If the same issue comes back within that time, we'll fix it again at no charge. The warranty doesn't cover new damage, liquid damage after the repair, or issues from third-party repairs done afterward. It also transfers with the device, so if you sell or gift the phone, the new owner is still covered for the remaining warranty period as long as they have the original receipt [2].

cases.question: Does the warranty cover if I drop my phone again after the repair?
cases.answer: The warranty covers defects in parts and workmanship for 90 days, but it does not cover new physical damage like dropping your phone again [1]. If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!

cases.question: How long does a screen repair usually take?
cases.answer: Most screen repairs are completed the same day, usually within two to three hours of drop-off [2].

cases.question: How long will a water damage assessment take?
cases.answer: A water damage assessment takes 3 to 5 business days. This is because it requires a diagnostic soak and component-level testing [2].

cases.question: What happens if you need to order a part for my rarer phone model?

cases.question: Do I need to book an appointment before coming in?

cases.question: What happens if I don't pick up my phone after it's repaired?

If you can't pick it up within 30 days, a small daily storage fee may apply unless you let us know in advance that you'll be delayed [2].

cases.question: Can I get my device fixed after hours?
cases.answer: You can drop off your device during business hours, which are Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm, and Saturday 10am to 2pm. If you need to pick it up after hours, just ask at drop-off and the team will arrange it for you [2].

cases.question: If the repair fails, do I still owe anything?
cases.answer: No, if the repair fails you don't owe anything. If we are unable to complete a repair, you owe nothing and get your device back as-is [3].

cases.answer: Yes, you can get a full refund within 14 days of picking up your repaired phone, as long as the part hasn't been damaged by misuse [3].

cases.question: Is the diagnostic fee waived if I go ahead with the repair?
cases.answer: Yes, the diagnostic fee is waived if you proceed with the recommended repair [2].

cases.answer: No, we never access personal data, accounts, or photos during a hardware repair. We only work on the hardware itself. If you're concerned, you can back up your data before bringing your phone in [4].

cases.question: How much is a screen replacement for a budget Android?

cases.question: What do you charge for a standard battery replacement?
cases.answer: A standard battery replacement is $49 for most phones, or $69 for flagship models with larger batteries [1].

cases.question: What's the diagnostic fee?
cases.answer: The diagnostic fee is 20 dollars, but it's waived if you go ahead with the recommended repair [1].

cases.question: How much is the rush service add-on?
cases.answer: The rush service add-on is a flat 15 dollar fee on top of the repair price [1].

cases.question: What happens if I don't pick my phone up for a month?

cases.question: Can I get a refund after I've picked the phone up?
cases.answer: Yes, you can get a full refund within 14 days of picking up your phone as long as the part hasn't been damaged by misuse [3].
